product_offering_family_not_self_check.name: product_offering_family_not_self_check
product_offering_family_not_self_check.value: family_offering_id IS NULL OR family_offering_id <> product_offering_id

product_offering_price_period_value_chec.name: product_offering_price_period_value_check
product_offering_price_period_value_chec.value: recurring_charge_period_type IS NULL OR (recurring_charge_period_type = 'months' AND recurring_charge_period_length IN (1, 3, 12))

product_offering_price_unit_value_check.name: product_offering_price_unit_value_check
product_offering_price_unit_value_check.value: unit_of_measure IS NULL OR unit_of_measure IN ('Mbps', 'GB', 'MB', 'EA')

product_offering_price_usage_rate_check.name: product_offering_price_usage_rate_check
product_offering_price_usage_rate_check.value: component_type <> 'usage_rate' OR (unit_of_measure IS NOT NULL AND recurring_charge_period_length IS NULL AND recurring_charge_period_type IS NULL AND COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(price_component #> '{params,ratePerUnit}'), 'missing') = 'string' AND price_component #>> '{params,ratePerUnit}' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')

product_offering_price_flat_fee_check.name: product_offering_price_flat_fee_check
product_offering_price_flat_fee_check.value: component_type <> 'flat_fee' OR (unit_of_measure IS NULL AND COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(price_component #> '{params,amount}'), 'missing') = 'string' AND price_component #>> '{params,amount}' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' AND COALESCE(price_component ->> 'priceType', '') IN ('recurring', 'oneTime') AND ((price_component ->> 'priceType' = 'recurring' AND recurring_charge_period_length IS NOT NULL AND recurring_charge_period_type IS NOT NULL) OR (price_component ->> 'priceType' = 'oneTime' AND recurring_charge_period_length IS NULL AND recurring_charge_period_type IS NULL)))

product_offering_price_capacity_commitme.name: product_offering_price_capacity_commitment_check
product_offering_price_capacity_commitme.value: component_type <> 'capacity_commitment' OR (unit_of_measure IS NOT NULL AND recurring_charge_period_length IS NULL AND recurring_charge_period_type IS NULL AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(price_component #> '{params,committedQuantity}') = 'number' THEN (price_component #>> '{params,committedQuantity}')::numeric > 0 ELSE false END)

product_offering_price_capacity_motivati.name: product_offering_price_capacity_motivation_check
product_offering_price_capacity_motivati.value: component_type <> 'capacity_motivation' OR (unit_of_measure IS NOT NULL AND recurring_charge_period_length IS NULL AND recurring_charge_period_type IS NULL AND product.pricing_steps_ok(price_component #> '{params,steps}'))

bill_run_approver_distinct_check.name: bill_run_approver_distinct_check
bill_run_approver_distinct_check.value: approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> triggered_by

bill_run_account_stage_error_class_check.name: bill_run_account_stage_error_class_check
bill_run_account_stage_error_class_check.value: error_class IS NULL OR error_class IN ('HARD','SOFT','INFRA')

product_order_reviewer_check.name: product_order_reviewer_check
product_order_reviewer_check.value: reviewed_by IS NULL OR reviewed_by <> submitted_by

product_inventory_end_after_start_check.name: product_inventory_end_after_start_check
product_inventory_end_after_start_check.value: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date

generated.as: CASE WHEN status IN ('RATED','BILL_DRAFT','BILL_APPROVED') THEN true END

udr_rated_discount_type_check.name: udr_rated_discount_type_check
udr_rated_discount_type_check.value: udr_discount_type IS NULL OR udr_discount_type IN ('fixed','percentage')

process_log_severity_check.name: process_log_severity_check
process_log_severity_check.value: perceived_severity IS NULL OR perceived_severity IN ('CRITICAL','MAJOR','MINOR','WARNING','INDETERMINATE','CLEARED')
